versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D — UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
See AMC.671
(a) Each control must operate easily, smoothly and positively enough to allow proper performance of its functions.
(b) Not applicable in this subpart (see USAR.1731 Controls - General)
(c) Each flight control system shall have a fatigue evaluation determined in accordance with USAR 570 at least equal to the specified life of the UAV, unless otherwise agreed with the Certifying authority. This shall be demonstrated by a fatigue test.
